headword: {相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}

definitions.explanation: A combined effect that is greater than the sum of individual effects; when multiple elements work together to produce an enhanced result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{効|き}き{目|め}→効き目：19884_kikime⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まった→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: The synergistic effect of the two medications increased their effectiveness.

examples.japanese: ⟦チームワーク→チームワーク：10995_chiimuwaaku⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
examples.english: Aiming for a synergistic effect through teamwork.

examples.japanese: ⟦マーケティング→マーケティング：05222_maaketingu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧SNS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Sales increased significantly due to the synergy between marketing and social media.

notes:
{相乗効果|そうじょうこうか} describes a combined effect greater than the sum of its parts. A compound of ⟦{相乗|そうじょう}→相乗：28174_soujou⟧ (mutual multiplication) + ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (effect). Often translated as "synergy."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: synergy is created
- {相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧: to produce synergy
- {相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to aim for synergy
- {相乗効果|そうじょうこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期待|きたい}できる→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧: synergy can be expected

USAGE:
Used in business (mergers, marketing), medicine (drug interactions), and science. Tends toward formal register.

RELATED WORDS:
- シナジー: synergy (loanword, common in business)
- ⟦{相互|そうご}{作用|さよう}→相互作用：20138_sougosayou⟧: interaction (neutral)
- ⟦{波及|はきゅう}{効果|こうか}→波及効果：09608_hakyuukouka⟧: ripple effect (spreading rather than multiplying)
